text:
kevin: Starting a 10% staged rollout for release v2.3.1 (image rwd-infer:v2.3.1) to eu-west. Change window 10:00-14:00 PT. @deploy-bot please start. @sre-oncall FYI

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Started staged rollout job r12345. Shifting 10% traffic to rwd-infer:v2.3.1 in eu-west. ETA ~5m. Monitor /ops/releases. To abort: /deploy abort r12345 :rocket:

lia: noticing a small latency spike on canaries — 95p 120ms -> 260ms in the last 2m. can we hold and triage?

sre-oncall: on it, pulling canary logs now. @ops can you confirm infra autoscaling didn't trigger unexpectedly?

ops: no HPA events. k8s metrics look steady. checking edge proxy logs now.

ops: ```log
2026-03-22T14:07:12Z canary-1 502 backend_timeout
2026-03-22T14:07:14Z canary-2 200 ok
2026-03-22T14:07:16Z canary-3 503 upstream_reset
```

maya: could be a kv-cache miss storm during warmup — new model variant load might be thrashing cache. any differences in startup timing?

kevin: hold rollout for now. @deploy-bot pause r12345

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Rollout r12345 paused at 10% by kevin. No more traffic shifts. Recommend 10m stable window before resuming. Use /deploy resume r12345 to continue.

lia: agree with hold. I'll run quick prompt-set regression and watch tails. :eyes:

sre-oncall: seeing elevated tail and increased kv eviction events on canary nodes. investigating model loader path. if this persists we should pin eu-west back to v2.3.0 until fix.

kevin: good plan — keep eu-west pinned to v2.3.0 for now. opening ticket INF-2467 for model loader investigation. ping when you have a remediation or want to resume. :thumbsup:
